# Utility Materials

Utility Materials is a dense, high-contrast dark theme aimed at long-form technical writing, dense notes and systems thinking. It keeps interface chrome minimal and uses a restrained industrial orange as a semantic status accent rather than decoration. The recorded description names Monaspace Krypton Frozen as the font its spacing and rhythm were tuned for.

![Utility Materials screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexh/umi-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Utility Materials"
    author: "alexh"
    repo:   "alexh/umi-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "utility-materials"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/utility-materials"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/alexh/umi-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alexh/umi-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a dense, high-contrast dark theme tuned for long-form technical writing, dense notes, and systems thinking. Minimize chrome, use a restrained industrial orange as a semantic status accent, and prefer Monaspace Krypton Frozen for the intended tight spacing and rhythm."
}
```
